english.title: Breach requirement in a serious disruption prevention order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to do something that you were required to do, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT..), by a serious disruption prevention order made at **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ORDER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27(1)(a) and (2) of the Public Order Act 2023.

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2023 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
